Text: “We found an ancient trade vessel, centuries old, with such incredible weapons aboard”

{D(Char)} grins as {he(Char)} handles a pre-Collapse laser rifle.

“Marvellous!” {he(Char)} gasps, pointing the deadly weapon at a dozen critical points in the ship’s hull. “There are five in all. I’m entitled to keep this one for myself, surely?”
{He(Char)} has even taken up lessons in shooting, drills and weapon safety.

"These weapons were created to oppress," you cry. "To attain the illusion of order by destroying the people they were supposed to protect."

The crowd watches as you disassemble the rifles and stamp on the components. They crack like bones.

"No more. This new world needs cooperation. Peace. It needs good men and women who reject the mistakes of the past."
